turns.replyText:
Hi Nora, I’m Nova AI, Fashion Nova’s AI customer care assistant. I’m not a human.

For a damaged item, the next step is to send photos so our care team can review it. Please attach: (1) a clear photo of the damage, (2) a photo of the item’s tag, and (3) a photo of the packing slip (if you still have it).

turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyText: Yes. Damaged items aren’t handled through the normal returns portal flow, they’re reviewed by our care team based on photos you send in chat. Normal returns (unworn, unused, tags attached) are submitted through the [Fashion Nova Returns Portal](https://returns.fashionnova.com/fashionnova/returns) within 30 days of delivery and are refunded as store credit.
